description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Plot_Bar', which implements a bar chart plotting utility within the Image_Graph package. It includes methods for setting bar spacing, width, and rendering the bar plot on a canvas, extending a base plotting class.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Plot_Bar
classes.description: A class for rendering bar charts within the Image_Graph PHP graphing utility, supporting various bar styles, spacing, and width configurations.

methods.name: setSpacing
methods.description: Sets the space between two bars, should be an even number.

methods.name: setBarWidth
methods.description: Sets the width of the bars, supporting 'auto' or specific pixel/percentage values.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Performs the final rendering of the bar plot on the canvas, handling bar placement, stacking, and styling.
